title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Appointment of Charley Brady as Head of Investor Relations
summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced the appointment of Charley Brady as Head of Investor Relations.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 2, 2026** – Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) (“Bit Digital” or the “Company”), a publicly listed Strategic Asset Company focused on Ethereum strategies and AI/HPC infrastructure, today announced the appointment of Charley Brady as Head of Investor Relations.


Brady brings more than 20 years of experience spanning sell-side equity research, capital markets, and investor relations. Most recently, he served as Vice President of Investor Relations at BitFuFu Inc. (Nasdaq: FUFU), where he led investor relations activities and supported the company’s capital markets initiatives and communications with the investment community. Previously, Brady spent more than 15 years as a sell-side equity research analyst covering diversified industrial companies.


“Charley brings a valuable combination of capital markets experience, analytical expertise, a deep understanding of institutional investors, and firsthand investor relations expertise in the digital asset sector,” said Sam Tabar, Chief Executive Officer of Bit Digital. “His background on both the sell side and in investor relations gives him a strong perspective on how investors evaluate companies and their strategies. We believe his experience will enhance our engagement with the investment community and support clear communication of Bit Digital’s capital allocation priorities and long-term objectives.”


“Having spent much of my career analyzing public companies and engaging with institutional investors, I understand the importance of clear, consistent, and transparent communication,” said Brady. “Bit Digital’s strategic focus on Ethereum and its majority ownership in WhiteFiber present a differentiated combination of digital asset and AI infrastructure exposure. I look forward to working with the management team to deepen investor engagement and help the market better understand the Company’s strategy, financial position, and underlying value drivers.”


Brady’s appointment comes as Bit Digital continues to advance its Strategic Asset Company strategy at the intersection of digital assets and AI/HPC infrastructure through its active participation in the Ethereum network and its majority ownership of WhiteFiber, Inc. (Nasdaq: WYFI).


**About Bit Digital** Bit Digital (NASDAQ: BTBT) is a Strategic Asset Company (SAC) focused on active participation in Ethereum infrastructure and controlling equity exposure to AI/HPC infrastructure through its majority ownership stake in WhiteFiber (NASDAQ: WYFI). The Company purchases and stakes ETH to generate protocol-native yield and participates directly in the Ethereum network. Bit Digital allocates capital with a focus on long-duration, foundational infrastructure, and disciplined balance sheet management.
